Date April 6, 1940

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. REGISTRY
No. S. R. D. 9931

Subject BRICK, "Jack" Jacob Leon - Communication from British
Consulate-General dated April 1, 1940

Made by D.S. Henchman Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

Jacob Leon "Jack" BRICK, Russian Jew, was
born at Semiplatinsk, Siberia, on 14th October,
1884. He was a registered Soviet citizen until
1934 when he is alleged to have surrendered his
Soviet passport to the Public Safety Bureau and
to have taken out emigration papers, at the same
time registering himself and his family with the
Russian Emigrants Committee. Despite his apparent
volte face BRICK, while registering with the White
Russian organization, is believed to have retained
his Soviet identity and have maintained his
connections with Soviet citizens in Siberia.

BRICK who is a chemist by profession and
who graduated in chemistry at the Tomsk University,
came to China in 1921. He spent six months in
Tientsin and then moved to Shanghai where he was
employed as manager of the Soviet Trade Mission.
He remained with the trade mission until 1927
when that organ was dissolved, the majority of its
personnel returning to Russia. BRICK, however,
stayed in Shanghai and set up in business as a
broker. He achieved a certain degree of success
and became well known in circles of rather doubtful
reputation. At present he shares an office at
Room 106-A in the Glen Line Building, 2 Peking Road,
with one Abraham KATZ, a Jew with Soviet affiliations.
He is engaged in the import/export business and

由 D.S. Henchman 撰写 经 D.I. Crawford 转呈

Jacob Leon "Jack" BRICK，俄籍犹太人，
于1884年10月14日出生于西伯利亚塞米巴拉金斯克（Semiplatinsk）。他一直是注册苏联公民，直到1934年，据称他向公共安全局（Public Safety Bureau）交出了苏联护照并办理了移民文件，同时将其本人及家属在俄国移民委员会登记。尽管表面上态度突变，BRICK 在向白俄组织登记的同时，被认为仍保留其苏联身份，并与西伯利亚的苏联公民保持联系。

BRICK 职业为化学家，毕业于托木斯克大学化学系，
于1921年来华。他在天津逗留了六个月，随后移居上海，受雇担任苏联贸易代表团经理。
他一直留在该贸易代表团直至1927年该机构解散，其大部分人员返回俄国。然而，BRICK 留居上海，以经纪人身份开业。他取得了一定程度的成功，并在一些声誉不佳的圈子里颇有名气。目前，他与一名具有苏联背景的犹太人 Abraham KATZ 共用北京路2号格兰轮船公司大楼（Glen Line Building）106-A室的办公室。他从事进出口贸易业务，并且

        BRICK resides at Apartment 24, House 3,

British Consulate-General,
SHANGHAI,
1st April 1940.

Dear Mr. Yorke,

I should be obliged for any information
you may have concerning the firm of Jack Brick &
Company, which is said to have an office at Room 106A,
Glen Line Building. Mr. Jack Brick is reputed to be
a British subject, but he is not registered here, and
at present he appears to be acting as a cloak for
Reuter, Brockelmann & Company.

Yours sincerely,
〔此处为手写签名〕

R. W. Yorke, Esquire,
Assistant Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

〔批：PA / Rep. 1/4  D.S. ... 〔此处转录不清〕〕

英国总领事馆，
上海，
1940年4月1日。

亲爱的约克先生：

如蒙提供有关 Jack Brick & Company 商行的任何信息，我将不胜感激，据说该商行在北京路格兰轮船公司大楼106A室设有办公室。Jack Brick 先生据称为英国臣民，但他并未在此注册，且目前他似乎正为 Reuter, Brockelmann & Company 充当掩护。

此致
敬礼，
〔此处为手写签名〕

R. W. Yorke 先生，
助理总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。
